item.title: Man spits on Sault security guard
item.description: A man spat on a security guard in the 700 block of Wellington Street East early Tuesday, police say. He’s also accused of trying to spit on, and bite, security guards in the 700 block of Great Northern Road that evening. item.title: Nominations open for Thessalon's Senior of the Year
item.description: Nominations are open for Thessalon’s Senior of the Year. Application forms are available at the municipal office at 187 Main St., a release says. Deadline is March 27 at 3 p.m. The recipient will be recognized during Canada Day celebrations on July 1. Call 705-842-2217 for more information.

item.title: Truck clips transport near Bruce Mines
item.description: A pickup truck flipped after clipping a transport during an attempted passing on Highway 17, near Bruce Mines, on Wednesday morning. The westbound truck hit the front of the tractor-trailer and went out of control, coming to rest on its roof in the northbound ditch. The truck was demolished. item.title: Dubreuilville mine production falls short in 2025
item.description: A Dubreuilville-area mine site’s production of 250,400 ounces of gold in 2025 fell short of guidance. Alamos Gold’s Island Gold District was projected to produce 260,000 to 270,000 ounces. item.title: After a week of Olympic curling controversy, Sault's Jacobs books ticket to gold-medal game
item.description: Canada's Team Brad Jacobs downed Norway's Magnus Ramsfjell 5-4 in extra ends in a tense semifinal of the Olympic curling bonspiel.
